var currentTab = 'new-card'; // initial tab is new-card, no submit needed on load

function switchTab(tabId, btn) {
  var previousTab = currentTab;

  document.querySelectorAll("#paymetric-payment-widget .tab-panel").forEach(function(p) {
    p.classList.remove("active");
  });
  document.querySelectorAll("#paymetric-payment-widget .tab-btn").forEach(function(b) {
    b.classList.remove("active");
  });
  document.getElementById("tab-" + tabId).classList.add("active");
  btn.classList.add("active");

  currentTab = tabId;

  // only trigger when switching back from saved-card to new-card
  if (tabId === 'new-card' && previousTab === 'saved-card') {
    submitForNewCardTab();
  }
}

// ─── Submit call when switching back to New Card tab ─────────────────────────
function submitForNewCardTab() {

    { key: "requestType",   value: "NEW_CARD_TAB" },
    { key: "resultURL",          value: OpfContext.resultURL }
  ];

  window.Opf.payments.checkout.submit({

    submitSuccess: function(response) {

      console.log("Just update the newCardFlag to true");

        var map = new Map(response.customFields.map(function(obj) { return [obj.key, obj.value]; }));

// ─── Normalize token fields (trim whitespace/newlines) ───────────────────────
function normalizeToken(token) {
  return {
    cardType:           (token.cardType          || "").trim(),
    cardLast4:          (token.cardLast4          || "").trim(),
    cardHolderName:     (token.cardHolderName     || "").trim(),
    cardExpiryDate:     (token.cardExpiryDate     || "").trim(),
    pspPaymentMethodId: (token.pspPaymentMethodId || "").trim()
  };
}

// ─── Render saved token dropdown ──────────────────────────────────────────────
function renderSavedTokenDropdown(tokens) {
  var select = document.getElementById("savedCardSelect");
  if (!select) return;

  // clear all except placeholder
  while (select.options.length > 1) select.remove(1);

  if (!tokens || tokens.length === 0) return;

  tokens.forEach(function(rawToken, index) {
    var t = normalizeToken(rawToken);
    var label = (t.cardType ? t.cardType + " " : "") +
                "****" + t.cardLast4 +
                (t.cardExpiryDate ? " - " + t.cardExpiryDate : "");
    var opt = document.createElement("option");
    opt.value = index;
    opt.textContent = label;
    select.appendChild(opt);
  });
}

// ─── Dropdown change handler ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
function onSavedCardSelectChange(select) {
  var index = parseInt(select.value, 10);
  if (isNaN(index) || !savedTokens[index]) {
    document.getElementById("PaymentCreditCard").value = "";
    document.getElementById("PaymentCardType").value   = "";
    document.getElementById("Name").value              = "";
    document.getElementById("CardExpiryDate").value    = "";
    document.getElementById("CVV").value               = "";
    return;
  }
  var t = normalizeToken(savedTokens[index]);
  document.getElementById("PaymentCreditCard").value = "**** **** **** " + t.cardLast4;
  document.getElementById("PaymentCardType").value   = t.cardType;
  document.getElementById("Name").value              = t.cardHolderName;
  document.getElementById("CardExpiryDate").value    = t.cardExpiryDate;
  document.getElementById("CVV").value               = "";
  retriveAccessTokenForSavedCard(t.pspPaymentMethodId, t.cardExpiryDate, t.cardType, t.cardHolderName);
}

// ─── Retrieve access token for saved card ────────────────────────────────────
function retriveAccessTokenForSavedCard(pspPaymentMethodId, cardExpiryDate, cardType, cardHolderName) {
  var parts    = (cardExpiryDate || "").split("/");
  var expMonth = (parts[0] || "").trim();
  var expYear  = (parts[1] || "").trim();

  var additionalData = [
    { key: "requestType",        value: "ACCESSTOKEN" },
    { key: "pspPaymentMethodId", value: pspPaymentMethodId },
    { key: "expMonth",           value: expMonth },
    { key: "expYear",            value: expYear },
    { key: "resultURL",          value: OpfContext.resultURL },
    { key: "cardType",           value: cardType },
    { key: "cardHolderName",     value: cardHolderName }
  ];

  window.Opf.payments.checkout.submit({
    additionalData: additionalData,
    submitSuccess: function(response) {
      console.log("retriveAccessTokenForSavedCard success", response);
    },
    submitPending: function(response) {
      if (response && response.customFields && response.customFields.length > 0) {
        var map = new Map(response.customFields.map(function(obj) { return [obj.key, obj.value]; }));
        savedCardAccessToken = map.get("savedCardAccessToken");
        savedCardSignature   = map.get("savedCardSignature");
        console.log("savedCardAccessToken", savedCardAccessToken);
        console.log("savedCardSignature",   savedCardSignature);
      }
    },
    submitFailure: function(response) {
      console.error("retriveAccessTokenForSavedCard failure", response);
    },
    submitCancel: function() {
      window.location.href = "/checkout/opf-payment-and-review";
    }
  });
}

// ─── 3DS Challenge handler (modal popup, no jQuery) ──────────────────────────
var dynamicIframeLoadCount = 0;

function CustomHandling(e) {
  if (!e || !e.HasPassed) return;
  if (document.getElementById("post_frame")) return;

  dynamicIframeLoadCount = 0;

  var dynamicIFrame = document.getElementById("DynamicIFrame");
  if (!dynamicIFrame) return;

  var overlay = document.getElementById("threeds-modal-overlay");
  if (overlay) overlay.style.display = "flex";

  var newIframe = document.createElement("iframe");
  newIframe.id     = "post_frame";
  newIframe.width  = "500px";
  newIframe.height = "600px";
  newIframe.style.border = "none";
  newIframe.onload = function() { Dynamic_Iframe(); };
  dynamicIFrame.appendChild(newIframe);

  var context = e.UrlsAndPayloadsFor3Ds;
  var form = parseInt(context.ThreeDSVersion) > 1
    ? build3DS2Form(context.StepUpUrl, context.JWT, context.PaymetricPayload)
    : build3DS1Form(context.CentinelAcsUrl, context.CentinelPayload, context.CentinelTermUrl, context.PaymetricPayload);

  newIframe.contentDocument.body.appendChild(form);
  form.submit();
}

function closeThreeDSModal() {
  var overlay = document.getElementById("threeds-modal-overlay");
  if (overlay) overlay.style.display = "none";
  var frame = document.getElementById("post_frame");
  if (frame) frame.remove();
}

    closeThreeDSModal();

function build3DS2Form(stepUpUrl, jwt, md) {
  var form = document.createElement("form");
  form.method = "post";
  form.action = stepUpUrl;

  var jwtInput = document.createElement("input");
  jwtInput.type = "hidden"; jwtInput.name = "JWT"; jwtInput.value = jwt;

  var mdInput = document.createElement("input");
  mdInput.type = "hidden"; mdInput.name = "MD"; mdInput.value = md;

  form.appendChild(jwtInput);
  form.appendChild(mdInput);
  return form;
}

  var form = document.createElement("form");
  form.method = "post";
  form.action = acsUrl;

  var pareqInput = document.createElement("input");
  pareqInput.type = "hidden"; pareqInput.name = "PaReq"; pareqInput.value = payload;

  var termInput = document.createElement("input");
  termInput.type = "hidden"; termInput.name = "TermUrl"; termInput.value = termUrl;

  var mdInput = document.createElement("input");
  mdInput.type = "hidden"; mdInput.name = "MD"; mdInput.value = md;

  form.appendChild(pareqInput);
  form.appendChild(termInput);
  form.appendChild(mdInput);
  return form;
}
